about_the_game:
Additional graphical content with cum-covered faces, bodies, handjobs, and gangbangs. These girls love the sperm!

  • 15 card sets (handjob-to-cumshot, facials, on body, FMM, MFF, gangbang, orgy)

  • 364 backgrounds

  • 780 card backs (use the same images as card sets)

  • 208 pictures to use in UI pop-ups and similar

  • 780 images are available for custom minigames. Make sure to set field tiling to roughly match the image proportions, to avoid cropping important detail (face, dicks, pussy).

Note: some backgrounds may be too colorful for some card sets. The new "bg color overlay" slider and a color picker in Options->Graphics will let you adjust backgrounds the way that feels best for you.

Images were AI-generated, with a lot of my manual sketches involved in the iterations.

Images are 2048 pixels in the bigger dimension. You could use them e.g. as wallpapers on your smartphone, laptop or other device. In Steam Library, select NSFW Solitaire, press "gear" button (Manage), Manage, Browse local files. This will open the game's folder in the file browser. Open DLC_Cumshots/Pictures. There in subfolders are 780 pictures. Those ending with  _v ("vertical") should be fine for a phone. Those ending with _h ("horizontal") are best as laptop/desktop backgrounds.
